hero.title: Build the strongest local Rumble team.
hero.copy: Scores every rumble-capable unit from stats, cooldowns, effects, role coverage, and team synergy, then fills five active slots and three bench slots.

actions.downloadTeamSupport: Build a valid Rumble team before downloading team data.

onlySupport.soft: Selected types guide scoring and can relax if needed.
onlySupport.strict: Every generated unit must use only the selected type(s).

onlySupport.soft: Selected classes guide scoring and can relax if needed.
onlySupport.strict: Every generated unit must have at least one selected class.

buffFocus.label: Buff focus
buffFocus.support: Higher lanes make the builder value those team buffs more. Stats in the same lane are averaged equally.

performance.title: Rumble worker preference
performance.copy: This Rumble build runs in one worker thread. The worker target is saved for builders that support pooled execution.
